title: nan
authors: Yakovlev K.; Khithov V.; Loginov M.; Petrov A.
key_contribution: Presents a ROS and 4D/RCS based distributed control and EKF-based marker mapping and SLAM system for multi-quadrotor cooperative navigation in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
